The Prism thesis ( and about calling bullshit ) 🧵

1One token: the Mothership.

Prism at it’s core is an ERC-20 on ethereum mainnet that takes advantage of Uniswap’s V4 hook magic for something of actual value in a sea of unicorns and gimmicky ponzinomics: by holding 1 whole prism, you get to accrue all LP fees, as well as the rest of ecosystem rewards, automatically. 

No stacking, no complexities, no liquidity to lock down.

In an era of defi exploits, of difficulty in bringing in new holders outside of the native’s bubble - this will be a core theme here - you get to abstract all that away.

This is some powerful mechanics, but what gives the token, and the exosystem at large, actual value? 

The app store: Prism is the one token unifying a burgeoning, curated ecosystem of apps designed to “call bullshit”. More on that later. 

It’s the one mothership: every single app in the ecosystem accrues value in to the only token: $prism. 

And the app that made it all click for me is Spectrum’s indexes👇

thread_tweets.text:
2Spectrum: the killer app(s)

Spectrum is the “first child” of @ColbySaysHi and the team @IroraCapital. Great and seasoned developers and good people trying to leave a mark and build their legacy. They led what has basically been a community rebirth in Prism, and done so creating a very simple primitive that is an absolute pillar of traditional finance somehow culpably absent in crypto so far: Indexes.

The 0 to 1 moment for @spectrumindexes will probably be when quality KOL start running the math on fees and launching their own basket: they’ll realize they can print infinite with a good basket, respawn the print higher and higher as volume scales, and doing it while providing a service to their audience instead of dumping bundled trash on their heads. 

Fee on the basket is to be selected by the person who launches it in a 1% to 3% range: the low range of what tardfi private funds or niche ETF and Indexes have been charging for decades.

30% goes to the Index launcher. 
20% buys and burns $Prism forever.

AND.

50% goes to basket holders. 

And this is what changes the whole value proposition: you are basically getting paid to hold your favourite index, instead of paying an annual fee. No one really understands the impilcations of that in depth: you now have an army of bagworkers automatically incentivized to work for your index, built in an evergrowing, eyeball attracting platform from day1.

Finally, because this is not a fucking gimmick, the basket is not synthetic liquidity: there is no “index amm” for phantom liquidity that can get rugges, this actually buys the underlying that is always redeemable by you 1:1 at any moment.
So it benefits projects included in the basket too. 

And that’s the last piece of the exponential puzzle: projects will WANT to be in there: volume, eyeballs, legitimacy if the Index is from respected big names. 

So you have the “ultimate bagworkers” in there too, the projects themselves, with whatever extra incentive they’ll wanna throw in the mix: extra yeld for DeFi’s all stars ETF? A TV spot for podcast show hosts baskets? Airdrops for NFT bros Index? 

No one cracked Indexes/ETF because tek, to some extent, sure, and now we have that. But also, frankly, mainly ‘cause greed: fees where never enough, there was always shady backroom deals, or some weird synthetic low liquidity pool to nuke, and why would holders ever be paid? But to work, this has to all be extremely simple, social, one click. Enter portfolio 👇

thread_tweets.text:
3Portfolio: AI and onboarding

Portfolio is the new addition to the equation. And shows once more how focused the team is on ux and the central importance it has for onboarding nocoiners. It’s basically a portfolio manager/creator. With advanced AI assist and automation. There are dozens of projects that do this out there, with no moat, sloppy execution, and hundreds of millions of mcap to vacuum. “Calling bullshit” is what Prism is doing here, again: you don’t need a whole new project, another KOL extraction, you really don’t need another token at all if you’re honest. It should just be one more layer of your defi project, and here it is, adding another multiplying factor to the Prism equation.

With one click, mutlichain, you create your own portfolio/index. No more gas fees, bridging, multiple wallets, hassle. The fee is 0.4%: half to provider and half to, you guessed it, buying and burning $prism. 
The team is being maniacal about routing and execution, as it should be. Most of you are paying obscene amounts in both fee and slippage trading via fomo/pump.fun or rawdogging your wallet, phantom or metamask or whatever. And almost no one uses aggregators. This will be a nice change of pace and will give you better execution far beyond the 0.4% alone. Like we said you’ll blocktronics analytics on your holdings, a bloomber style news feed will be integrated later this year, a proper deck.

More. Agentic basket creation is now LIVE. In both the fact that you can have AI assisted basket creation, and also rhere are skills for your agent or claw to create indexes thenselves autonomously! As we nove forward, more and more agentic usage is projected, far surpassing human one. And this is futureproofing that.

The onboard flow is what matters to me here, once more, the simple stuff: slide a lever, and your private portfolio goes public miniting it as your own index in seconds. One click. 

And a whole social layer app is being built around that as well, leaderboards for the best portfolios, incentives: social trading is here to stay, and this is very clear to everyone at Prism.

thread_tweets.text:
4. The APP STORE and calling bullshit.

And this is where it all ties up together for me. Prism is a mothership welcoming and onboarding new developers to it’s ecosystem week after week.  

In a few days a seasoned game designer will release Lightrunners, a survival skill game that will beat most of the “web3 games” out there that took in millions and delivered nothing, sunsetting themselves and investor’s fund one after another. There will be tournaments, money games, and of course 10% of all that will buy and burn Prism.

Again, they’re calling bullshit.

It’s uniquely called bullshit on distro too, one of the best in class given it’s unique history, and how hardened the holder base is. This is tough to replicate, and an incredibly important and vastly underrate factor in a project’s success. Very few tourists left.

There’s an NFT collection, Prismies, in the works that looks great, and will have some incredibly innovative mechanics and function powering it. Calling bullshit on all the copy pasta slop of recent times. 

All priced in and accruing value to Prism, of course.

There are hundreds of millions of dollars of “empty market cap” out there of V4 launchpads that no one cares for and uses: so why not build one in Prism, and call bullshit on that too? Just as one more service, and one more value accrual avenue for Prism holders. You drain some of that empty marketcap too. And that’s true for so many apps and defi services that do not need millions and one more useless token. 

The platform is open to submissions. So many teams and indie devs are getting in touch with Colby, excited to build on Prism. It can scale endlessly. 

The risks are obviously there, mostly adoption both in users and dev work in my mind. That’s not small. But also not at this stage an issue: the project is two weeks old and already has in the pipeline more than 99% of the shit out there.

This is clearly not financial advice, not a paid post, and of course I own a large bag: I see a lot of potential here. 
All I’m saying is: click on https://t.co/hipodf0vxA 

Spend 2 minutes there and see for yourself. Try the apps. Turn on the prism radio, enjoy the beats, and checkout the future of crypto onboarding.
